IndexTTSLocalScriptDubbing.description: One marked-up script in, multi-role and multi-emotion dubbing plus frame-accurate subtitles out. Markers look like [@R0] or [@R1:raging]; they must start at column 0.

text.name: text
text.tooltip: Script with segment markers; the default is the 17-segment feature sample. Empty text raises an error

ref_audio.name: ref_audio
ref_audio.tooltip: Reference-voice sockets: 1st = R0, 2nd = R1, …; unconnected slots fall back to built-in roles

lang.name: lang
lang.tooltip: Language: controls tokenization and the pronunciation dictionary (not translation). Use ZH for mixed Chinese/English scripts

gap_ms.name: gap_ms
gap_ms.tooltip: Silence inserted between segments when merging (ms)

intro_ms.name: intro_ms
intro_ms.tooltip: Silence inserted at the head of the merged track (ms)

seed.name: seed
seed.tooltip: Version number: the same seed reuses cached segment files; change it to regenerate everything

emo_weight.name: emo_weight
emo_weight.tooltip: Emotion weight (emo_alpha): 0.65 by default, same as the WebUI; effective strength = written weight × upstream bias × this value

duration_factor.name: duration_factor
duration_factor.tooltip: Speech rate: 0.5 faster and shorter, 2.0 slower and longer; changing it regenerates every segment

cache_dir.name: cache_dir
cache_dir.tooltip: Subdirectory name under ComfyUI output (may be nested, e.g. my/tts); absolute paths are normalised so the cache always stays under the output directory

base_url.name: base_url
base_url.tooltip: IndexTTS WebUI address; only change it when the port is not 7860

0.tooltip: Segment dubbing: one clip per segment, length = segment count; empty/failed segments are 0.1s silence

1.tooltip: Merged dubbing: intro silence + segments + gaps

2.tooltip: Subtitles: SRT or JSON, one cue per segment, placeholders for failed segments

3.tooltip: Segment list: index / status / role / emotion / timing / text

4.tooltip: Voice report: whether each role used your reference audio or a built-in one

5.tooltip: Failed segments: index / text / server error; empty when everything succeeded

6.tooltip: Summary: segments / ok / failed / duration / elapsed / RTF
